snippet.title: Grey Wake | Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAYABLE DEMO IS OUT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3631930/Grey_Wake/

Support the game on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/secondfiddle/grey-wake

An award winning narrative sailing adventure. Chart a the archipelago that the dead call home in search of a long lost friend. Help others, and perhaps yourself, find a way to truly move on and let go of these mortal possessions.

Subscribe for email updates: https://secondfiddlestudio.dev/subscribe

Follow on X: https://x.com/secondfiddledev
